design_rationale: Four preregistered distinct physical episodes, minimal two repetitions per execution order to see signed contrasts and crude within-order dispersion. ABBA is fixed before outcomes; every episode uses a fresh table with the same verified logical source, measured initial file count and identical query/telemetry/rewrite/session configuration. This bounded screening pilot informs the next variance/common-horizon design; it does not determine final sample size or statistical acceptance. Stop and audit any failed gate before dependent work.
registered_statistics: Each of the four actual probe latencies, actual rewrite duration and task overlap
during minus arithmetic mean of before/after original-snapshot latency, with signed values preserved
compacted minus after-original latency reported separately
Individual values, mean and sample standard deviation only when at least two actual passed episodes exist; no confidence interval
analysis_limitations: Two episodes per order only: descriptive dispersion, not stable variance, confidence intervals or a sufficient training/calibration/test corpus.
Prespecified ABBA order balances position approximately but does not eliminate cache, host drift or serial dependence.
Arithmetic mean of original-snapshot before/after controls is an exploratory bracketing contrast, not an observed counterfactual or causal training target.
Compacted versus after-original contrast remains a separate layout comparison with cache/time confounding.
One Q1 query on controlled 16-file SF1 clones; no arrival replay, offered-load queueing, ingestion or workload/layout diversity.
REST/log/process observation overhead remains present. Actual task lifetimes overlap; simultaneous CPU execution not proven.
All attempted and failed/missed-exposure episodes are retained; stop the sequence after any failed gate, no retry until success or selective omission.
No cost training, conformal bounds, Model C promotion, scheduler benefit, model-count superiority or publication acceptance.
